why: CmuxNextAgentPane/AgentPaneRecord.swift: a running recording's observers, as MainActorObservation tokens: its one window's willClose, didMove and didResize (one call site mapped over the three names: the close ends the recording, a move or resize makes the stream follow the window with updateConfiguration off main, coalesced to one call in flight), and the app's willTerminate (capture-bar-DESIGN.md: it stops by itself when the window closes or the app quits, releasing its stream and writer). Registered only while a recording runs, on that one window, and cancelled on every end (stop, the 300 s limit, the close, a stream failure); at most one recording per app, so at most four observers at once.
